id: \rDo you want to learn a cool move?
en: \rDo you want to learn a cool move?

id: \bPokémon are pretty strong. Even the ones I get in town are powerful.
en: \bPokémon are pretty strong. Even the ones I get in town are powerful.
it: \bI Pokémon sono davvero forti. Anche quelli che trovo in città sono potenti.

id: \bI fished this up earlier but I don't need it.
en: \bI fished this up earlier but I don't need it.
it: \bL'ho pescato poco fa, ma non mi serve.

id: Dendemille Town\nA town where fluff dances on the wind.
en: Dendemille Town\nA town where fluff dances on the wind.
it: Frescovilla\nLa città dove la lanugine danza nel vento.

id: \rI'm trying to grow berries here. It's too cold for anything to last long.
en: \rI'm trying to grow berries here. It's too cold for anything to last long.
it: \rSto cercando di coltivare bacche qui. Fa troppo freddo perché qualcosa duri a lungo.

id: \bWatch me sweep you off your feet.
en: \bWatch me sweep you off your feet.
it: \bGuarda come ti faccio perdere la testa.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 415.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 415.
it: Smart Rotom: In base ai tuoi risultati, ora sei al posto 415 della classifica.

id: Announcment. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Dozer, located at Rock Tunnel above Lavender Town, is ready for battle.
en: Announcment. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Dozer, located at Rock Tunnel above Lavender Town, is ready for battle.
it: Annuncio. Trovato un nuovo avversario per le World Coronation Series. Dozer, al Tunnel Roccioso sopra Lavandonia, è pronto per la lotta.

id: \rLiving higher up means the air is cleaner. At least that's what we believe.
en: \rLiving higher up means the air is cleaner. At least that's what we believe.
it: \rVivere più in alto significa che l'aria è più pulita. Almeno, è quello che crediamo.

id: \bI hope you're careful going into the next route. It's a cold and snowy place.
en: \bI hope you're careful going into the next route. It's a cold and snowy place.
it: \bSpero che tu stia attento nel prossimo percorso. È un posto freddo e innevato.

id: \bA Performer just won a contest here. She seemed really happy.
en: \bA Performer just won a contest here. She seemed really happy.
it: \bUn'Artista Pokémon ha appena vinto una gara qui. Sembrava davvero felice.
